author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Anbernic's next handheld looks like a Switch Lite, but with a classic d-pad centric layout. It's their first Snapdragon device, but the G1 Gen 2 processor has its own share of advantages and disadvantages. Here are my initial impressions of this familiar-looking handheld.

Links coming soon (check back later)

CRT shaders for G1 Gen 2: https://www.reddit.com/r/SBCGaming/comments/1k9gwcd/crt_shaders_that_work_on_the_retroid_pocket/
A12 GPU drivers: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/work_items/14596#note_3421695

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this video ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
